nodes.name: Core-satellite superstructure assembly
nodes.procedure: The SERS-active Au@Ni3FeOx core-satellite superstructures were prepared by an electrostatic force-driven self-assembly method (Supporting Information, Figure S1). First, the Au core was coated with an ultrathin silica shell (Figure S2) to prevent it from direct contact with the reactive species. After that, Ni3FeOx NPs obtained by pyrolysis were assembled on the Au core. We chose a feeding ratio of 3:1 which resulted in a measured ratio of 77:23 from the obtained Ni3FeOx NPs (Figure S3b).

nodes.description: OER electrochemical-SERS monitoring in alkaline medium (1.0 M KOH)
nodes.source_text: In situ electrochemical-SERS was performed to detect OER intermediate species on the Ni₃FeOₓ surface (Figure S9). The SERS spectra were collected at 50 mV intervals in the potential range of 1.20-1.70 V... A pair of Raman bands at 1142 and 1170 cm⁻¹... appear from 1.25 V and become stronger... rapidly disappear at 1.40 V... As the potential increases, the Niᴵᴵ to Niᴵᴵᴵ oxidation appears at 1.36 V... O₂ concentration was evaluated at potentials of 1.350, 1.375 and 1.400 V.

top_O-O-_behavior.value: weak initially, sharp increase at 1.55 V

nodes.source_text: On Fe₃O₄ surface, the bridge-mode O-O⁻ (1145 cm⁻¹) shows a signal increase in the potential range from 1.25 to 1.55 V; while the band of top-mode O-O⁻ (1167 cm⁻¹) is very weak at the initial stage (1.25-1.55 V) and then increases sharply when the bridge-mode reaches a maximum signal intensity (1.55 V).

nodes.description: Acidic OER SERS control on Pt NPs
nodes.source_text: When the potential reaches 1.40 V, a Raman band appears around 1204 cm⁻¹, which becomes stronger as the potential increases... In deuterium replacement control experiment, this band red-shifts to 1185 cm⁻¹.

We used dissolved oxygen meter (DOM) to study the oxygen evolution process... the O₂ concentration was evaluated at potentials of 1.350, 1.375 and 1.400 V. No concentration increase was detected at 1.350 V... At 1.375 V, the O₂ concentration increases from 0.44 to 0.79 ppm.
